name: How do I know if my basement windows need replacement?

mainEntity.name: How do I know if my basement windows need replacement?

acceptedAnswer.text: Signs that your basement windows need replacement include drafts, condensation between glass panes, difficulty opening or closing, and visible damage like rot or rust on frames. If you notice a musty smell, increased energy bills, or water leaks around the window, these are strong indicators. Old single-pane windows are also candidates for replacement due to poor insulation. Modern windows offer better security, energy performance, and can update the look of your basement.
acceptedAnswer.description: Look for drafts, condensation, difficulty operating, visible damage, water leaks, or increased energy bills to determine if replacement is needed.
